learning_outcomes.curricular_goal: CG 2 – Explores the physical world around them, and understands scientific principles and laws based on observations and analysis

topics.name: Electric Current, Potential Difference and Ohm's Law
topics.description: Electric charge, current I = Q/t, ampere, electric potential and potential difference V = W/Q, volt, circuit diagrams, Ohm’s law V = IR, V-I characteristics.

subtopics.name: Electric Current and Potential Difference
subtopics.description: Flow of electrons, ammeter and voltmeter connections.

subtopics.name: Ohm’s Law and Resistance Definition
subtopics.description: Linear V-I graph, slope equals resistance.

topics.name: Resistance and Resistivity
topics.description: Factors on which resistance depends (length, cross-sectional area, material nature, temperature), resistivity (rho = RA/l), ohm-meter unit, conductors, alloys, and insulators.

subtopics.name: Factors Governing Resistance and Resistivity
subtopics.description: Resistivity tables and heating element alloys (nichrome).

topics.name: Series and Parallel Combinations of Resistors
topics.description: Equivalent resistance in series (Rs = R1 + R2 + ...), equivalent resistance in parallel (1/Rp = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + ...), current and voltage distributions, advantages of parallel in domestic circuits.

subtopics.name: Series and Parallel Derivations and Numericals
subtopics.description: Complex resistor network analysis.

subtopics.name: Domestic Circuit Layout Rationale
subtopics.description: Independent operation and minimal resistance advantages of parallel wiring.

topics.name: Heating Effect of Electric Current
topics.description: Joule’s law of heating H = I^2 R t, applications in electric toaster, iron, kettle, heater, electric bulb (tungsten filament, inert gas), electric fuse safety mechanism.

subtopics.name: Joule's Law and Thermal Applications
subtopics.description: Calculations of heat produced.

subtopics.name: Safety Fuse Operations
subtopics.description: Current ratings (1A, 2A, 5A, 15A) and low melting point alloy.

topics.name: Electric Power and Commercial Energy
topics.description: Definition of power P = VI = I^2 R = V^2/R, watt and kilowatt, commercial unit kilowatt-hour (1 kWh = 3.6 x 10^6 J), calculating domestic electricity bills.

subtopics.name: Power Formulas and Interrelations
subtopics.description: Numericals on power ratings across voltage changes.

subtopics.name: Commercial Electrical Energy and Costing
subtopics.description: Unit conversions and domestic tariff problem sets.

learning_outcomes.description: Manipulates and analyses different characteristics of the circuit (current, voltage, resistance) and mathematises their relationship (Ohm’s law), and applies it to everyday usage (electricity bill, short circuit, safety measures).
learning_outcomes.curricular_goal: CG 2 – Explores the physical world around them, and understands scientific principles and laws based on observations and analysis

topics.name: Magnetic Field and Field Lines
topics.description: Magnetic field, compass needle, bar magnet field lines, properties of magnetic field lines (closed continuous curves, tangent gives direction, no two lines intersect).
topics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

subtopics.name: Field Line Geometry and Properties
subtopics.description: Non-intersection proof and magnetic field vector.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

topics.name: Magnetic Field Due to Current Carrying Conductors
topics.description: Oersted experiment, field due to straight conductor, Right-Hand Thumb Rule, circular loop field pattern, solenoid magnetic field resembling bar magnet, electromagnet.
topics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

subtopics.name: Straight Conductor and Right-Hand Thumb Rule
subtopics.description: Concentric magnetic field circles.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

subtopics.name: Circular Loop and Solenoid
subtopics.description: Uniform core field and factors strengthening electromagnet.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

topics.name: Force on Current-Carrying Conductor in Magnetic Field
topics.description: Displacement of conductor in magnetic field, dependence on current, field, and length, Fleming’s Left-Hand Rule.
topics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

subtopics.name: Fleming's Left-Hand Rule
subtopics.description: Thumb-force, forefinger-magnetic field, middle finger-current.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

topics.name: Direct and Alternating Current and Domestic Electric Circuits
topics.description: Direct current (DC), Alternating current (AC), frequency of AC in India (50 Hz), advantage of AC over DC for long-distance transmission, domestic circuits: live (red/brown), neutral (black/blue), earth wire (green), grounding safety, short circuit, overloading.
topics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

subtopics.name: AC vs DC Transmission Advantages
subtopics.description: Voltage step-up/step-down and minimal energy loss.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

subtopics.name: Domestic Circuit Architecture and Grounding Safety
subtopics.description: 220V supply, three-pin plug, earth leakage protection.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Magnetic effects of current

topics.name: Electric Motor, Electromagnetic Induction and Generator (Formative Learning)
topics.description: Electric Motor, Electromagnetic Induction, Fleming’s Right-Hand Rule, Electric Generator. (Assessed only formatively in 2026-27 to reduce academic stress).
topics.source_section: Unit IV: Note on Formative Topics / Motor & Generator

subtopics.name: DC Motor Principle and Commutator Action
subtopics.description: Conversion of electrical energy into mechanical torque.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Note on Formative Topics / Motor & Generator

subtopics.name: Electromagnetic Induction and Generator
subtopics.description: Faraday’s discovery, induced EMF, AC and DC generator working.
subtopics.source_section: Unit IV: Note on Formative Topics / Motor & Generator

learning_outcomes.description: Develops accurate physical and directional vector models (Right-Hand Thumb Rule, Fleming’s Left-Hand Rule) to predict magnetic field lines and electromagnetic force directions.
learning_outcomes.curricular_goal: CG 8 – Explores the nature of Science by doing Science

topics.name: Ecosystem and Food Chains
topics.description: Ecosystem structure, biotic and abiotic components, producers, consumers (herbivores, carnivores, omnivores, parasites), decomposers, food chains and food webs, 10% law of energy transfer, biological magnification of pesticides.

subtopics.name: Trophic Levels and 10 Percent Law
subtopics.description: Unidirectional energy flow and biomass pyramids.

subtopics.name: Biological Magnification
subtopics.description: Progressive accumulation of non-biodegradable toxins across trophic tiers.

topics.name: Environmental Problems and Ozone Layer Depletion
topics.description: Atmospheric ozone (O3) formation by UV action on oxygen, protective function shielding UV radiation, causes of ozone depletion (chlorofluorocarbons - CFCs), international UNEP agreement freezing CFC production.

subtopics.name: Ozone Photochemistry and Destruction
subtopics.description: O2 + UV -> O + O; O + O2 -> O3, skin cancer and cataract hazards.

subtopics.name: Montreal Protocol and Global Action
subtopics.description: UNEP 1987 treaty phasing out ozone depleting substances.

topics.name: Waste Production and Solutions
topics.description: Biodegradable substances (broken down by biological processes) and non-biodegradable substances (persistent polymers, plastics), solid waste generation, municipal solid waste management solutions: composting, recycling, incineration, biogas, lifestyle modifications.

subtopics.name: Biodegradable vs Non-Biodegradable Waste
subtopics.description: Action of saprophytes and enzymes on organic matter versus persistent plastics.

subtopics.name: Sustainable Waste Management Systems
subtopics.description: Source segregation, sanitary landfills, recycling paradigms.

learning_outcomes.description: Analyses different levels of biological organisation from organisms to ecosystems and biomes along with interactions that take place at each level.
learning_outcomes.curricular_goal: CG 4 – Explores interconnectedness between organisms and their environment
